 Winners & Losers F1 Unlocked Brazil Show more tags F1 Correspondent & Presenter Lawrence Barretto Mercedes clinched the Teams' Championship for the first time since 2021 to spark a wild celebration in Brazil. Their Sunday afternoon wasn't straightforward, though, with wet conditions making for a challenging race. Lawrence Barretto selects his winners and losers from the Sao Paulo Grand Prix. 
 Winner: Lando Norris
 Lando Norris delivered one of the most accomplished drives of his racing career to master the wet-dry-wet conditions and clinch victory in Brazil.
